summary: Your mission concept and presentation are strong, and your Gantt-based plan is credible. However, the plan lacks contingency and a planned information-source list, and the editing timeline is inconsistent. Preliminary technical work is thin, and the GEO-at-600-km statement is a major error. Address these to raise C2 and C3.
next_steps: Correct the orbit statement in Orbit Specifics: a geostationary orbit is about 35,786 km, not 600 km; then add preliminary orbital calculations or STK outputs (e.g., COE/AOE) to show technical progress.

Revise Project Plan & Preliminary Progress: add an explicit planned information-source list, include contingency/variation provisions, and align the text (Weeks 7–8 editing) with the Gantt (Weeks 9–10).
Strengthen Mission Concept & Rationale by stating explicit quantitative mission objectives/requirements, and polish figure/table formatting to secure top presentation marks.

criteria.C1: Your Mission Concept & Rationale is strong: you clearly identify coral-reef monitoring users and the need for near-real-time relay, with relevant references. To secure the top of Accomplished, add explicit quantitative mission objectives and requirements (e.g., spatial resolution, revisit time, data latency) so the mission function is measurable.
criteria.C2: Your Gantt chart and task descriptions in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress make the plan credible. To reach Accomplished, add explicit contingency/variation provisions, a planned information-source list, and explain why the plan fits the mission concept. Also fix the inconsistency: text reserves Weeks 7–8 for editing/finalisation, but Image 1 shows Weeks 9–10.
criteria.C3: You completed STK tutorials 1–4 and background research, but preliminary technical work is thin. To reach Accomplished, present a good preliminary set of results with brief interpretation—e.g., orbital calculations, COE/AOE results or STK simulation outputs. Correct the Orbit Specifics error: GEO is ~35,786 km, not 600 km; 600 km is LEO and cannot stay fixed over the reef.
criteria.C4: Your report is well structured and readable, with footnotes and a legible, explained Gantt chart in Image 1. To secure the top of Accomplished, polish minor formatting and figure-detail issues so all graphical/table presentation is fully consistent and clear.
